title: Listening Drill — School water audit
description: Project planning dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: School water audit
sections.transcript:
COORDINATOR: Thanks for joining this planning meeting about school water use. The progress report is due on Tuesday. We need to agree what can be ready before then.

MEMBER: I'll start by checking the old readings. That should tell us whether the previous team has already solved part of the problem.

COORDINATOR: Good. For the trial we will use the main meter. Send your results to Joel first, not to the whole group. I don't want unconfirmed figures copied into the report.

MEMBER: Understood. We should also remember that the kitchen is closed next week. I'll make a note of that in the schedule.
